props.name: custom
props.comment:
Whether RouterLink should not wrap its content in an `a` tag. Useful when
using `v-slot` to create a custom RouterLink

props.name: activeClass
props.comment: Class to apply when the link is active

props.name: exactActiveClass
props.comment: Class to apply when the link is exact active

props.name: ariaCurrentValue
props.comment: Value passed to the attribute `aria-current` when the link is exact active.

props.name: viewTransition
props.comment: Pass the returned promise of `router.push()` to `document.startViewTransition()` if supported.

props.name: to
props.comment: Route Location the link should navigate to when clicked on.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { route: RouteLocationResolvedGeneric; href: string; isActive: boolean; isExactActive: boolean; navigate: (e?: MouseEvent | undefined) => Promise<void | NavigationFailure>; }
